description: UNTESTED on RTX 5060: hardware profiles for asset-gen's local branch use planning thresholds, not measured values; the user tests on the RTX 5060 8 GB machine after the merge. comfy-desktop-setup.py --check prints the best profile the machine meets; it never applies it, never downloads models and never installs packs.
units: GiB: VRAM = nvidia-smi memory.total MiB / 1024; RAM and free disk = bytes / 1024^3. A threshold sits a little under the nominal size because an 8 GB card reports about 7.9 GiB and a 32 GB machine about 31.8 GiB.

torch_arch.why: Blackwell GPUs (RTX 50xx, compute capability 12.0) have sm_120 kernels only in torch CUDA 12.8+ builds

profiles.nominal: any machine; images come from the ChatGPT image API through the 9router node
allows: ChatGPT image API through the 9router node

profiles.nominal: NVIDIA card with 4 GB VRAM, 16 GB RAM (SD1.5 class)
allows: one SD1.5 ControlNet at a time

models.need: a CLIP vision model compatible with the IPAdapter

profiles.nominal: NVIDIA RTX 5060 8 GB, 32 GB RAM (target machine; UNTESTED on RTX 5060)
allows: SDXL checkpoint, pruned fp16 or fp8, at 1024 px, batch 1
one SDXL ControlNet at a time
excludes: two or more SDXL ControlNets at once
optional_later: Flux GGUF (quantized), only as an optional later step

models.need: an SDXL checkpoint, pruned fp16 or fp8
a CLIP vision model compatible with the IPAdapter
